idea-plugin.name: PSI MCP Server
idea-plugin.description:
Exposes JetBrains PSI analysis capabilities via MCP (Model Context Protocol) for AI coding assistants.
Features: - Semantic code analysis via PSI - Find usages and references - Symbol discovery and navigation - Inheritance hierarchy analysis - HTTP API for external tool integration
This is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by JetBrains s.r.o. or Google LLC. "IntelliJ", "JetBrains", and "Android Studio" are trademarks of their respective owners.
License: MIT (see LICENSE file in the project repository)
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 0.1.0
  • Initial public release
  • PSI-backed navigation, search, and type inspection tools
  • Refactoring tools: rename, move, safe delete, extract interface, add parameter
  • Diagnostics, quick fixes, import handling, and formatting tools
  • Local HTTP endpoint for MCP clients
